def _dotpath_set(d: Dict[str, Any], dotpath: str, value: Any) -> None:
    """Set a nested dictionary value using dot notation."""
    keys = dotpath.split(".")
    current = d
    for key in keys[:-1]:
        if key not in current or not isinstance(current[key], dict):
            current[key] = {}
        current = current[key]
    current[keys[-1]] = value
